subject: C30
required_fixes: R1 — Medium: apps/desktop/src/v2/inbox/inbox.tsx:90-104 selects emptyPending whenever ReadStatus is pending, even when the core supplies actual setup-warning entries; lines 149-154 then suppress the row list. The existing production-interface test setup_warnings_are_inbox_entries_the_operator_can_hold_across_reads establishes exactly this valid combination: a completed setup has vw-1 while its Home read remains pending. Independently reproduced through production App/DesktopClient/Inbox: Home shows the warning, Inbox tabs say All 1 and Needs action 1, but the warning and its contextual/hold actions are absent. Without management credentials a Home read can be refused, leaving the warning inaccessible in Inbox indefinitely. Acceptance: render supplied entries independently of first-read status; component coverage must show, select, follow, acknowledge, snooze and restore a setup warning before any Home read, while a genuinely empty fresh tenant still shows the pending state.

R2 — Medium: apps/desktop/src/v2/home.tsx:20-49 and apps/desktop/src/v2/inbox/inbox.tsx:89-109 discard known source freshness when presenting an otherwise complete empty read. crates/desktop-core/src/authority/observation_domain.rs:678-689 correctly changes the overview from AllClear to Gap after its freshness window expires, but the new Home still says Nothing needs action with an allowed no-activity line, and Inbox says Nothing needs action without a stale qualification. Independently reproduced with a contract-valid one-hour-old healthy-empty overview, fresh=false and face=gap. This regresses C12's explicit requirement that expired sources remain distinct from healthy empty, retained by the parity matrix and selected architecture. Acceptance: preserve cached data but identify its stale coverage on Home and Inbox; tests must cross the core freshness deadline, including returning to a cached tenant, and distinguish fresh healthy-empty, expired, partial and failed states without silently refreshing.
